description.value: Western Front is a non-profit artist-run centre founded in 1973 in Vancouver's Mount Pleasant neighbourhood, housed in a distinctive three-story heritage building with green wooden siding and a pioneer-like false-front façade. It supports multidisciplinary programming spanning music, media art, visual art, performance, and literature, and maintains a growing audiovisual archive documenting decades of artistic production. Touring cyclists can lock bikes at racks directly in front of the building, with a Mobi bike-share station on the adjacent corner.

bike_parking_detail: 5 racks within 100m: rack (7 spaces) at 36m; stands (12 spaces) at 55m; stands (24 spaces) at 82m; stands (5 spaces) at 90m; stands at 96m. Total: 48 spaces.
